links.outcome: Clinician-reported multilingual support limits of ambient AI scribe
links.effect: Clinicians identified limited multilingual functionality as a persistent barrier in Singapore's multilingual healthcare system; no quantitative rates reported.
links.quote: Persistent barriers included accuracy concerns, AI hallucinations, limited multilingual functionality, loss of documentation style, and uncertainties around compliance with the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).
